newsitem.title: FRANCE: Efis Cargo satisified with Hercules performance.
newsitem.headline: Efis Cargo satisified with Hercules performance.

text.p: French cargo charter airline, Efis Cargo, said it was very satisfied with the volume of cargo charter activity achieved by its Lockheed Hercules L382G freighter.

"Since Efis began operating charter flights with the Hercules in July 1996, it's been recording around 100 flying hours per month which is in keeping with our forecasts," an Efis official told Reuters.
The L382G, which has a 22-tonne capacity, is based at Chateauroux-Deols airport in central France.
The aircraft is being leased from South African company, Safair Freighters Pty Ltd.

"The Hercules has carried shipments, largely in value-added high-tech goods category, to a number of destinations worldwide, notably the Gulf States, South America and in Europe. However, one of its latest flights was a humanitarian aid mission to Zaire carrying emergency supplies," the official said.
A longer term objective for Efis Cargo is to operate a second aircraft, probably of the same type, the official added.

Efis recently chartered two Antonov 124 flights from Chateauroux to Nouakchott in Mauritania, carrying a consignment of 80 Peugeot cars to the West African state. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
